description: Land Title Settlement Dept - Doratiyawa, Mallawapitiya  D/S/D,kurunegala District (25/5514228)
categorisation: The gazette content is exclusively about the formal registration and declaration of land titles for specific parcels of land under the Registration of Title Act. It details the determination of ownership, including the owner's name, identity card number, address, and specific land particulars (parcel number, extent, class, encumbrances). This fits the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4), which covers land registrations, property ownership, and title settlements. It does not involve government personnel changes, portfolio assignments, or any of the other specialized non-land administrative matters.
